title: BrainCaptureDelta
description: Output contract for the headless brain-capture-delta classifier. Exactly one of the outcomes from PLAN_v3 §2.5 empty-capture lifecycle. Body fields are required only on CAPTURE_CREATED.

outcome.description: The classifier's verdict. (NO_NEW_ACTIVITY is decided pre-classifier by brain-capture.sh based on byte-marker comparison; ERROR is decided post-classifier on parse/spawn failures.)

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the outcome. Useful for log lines and quarantine review.

body.description: The capture body in markdown. REQUIRED if outcome=CAPTURE_CREATED. Use sections '## Decisions', '## Findings', '## Blockers / Open questions', '## State changes', '## Notes' as appropriate. Summarise tightly; do not paste raw secrets or auth headers.

project_slug.description: Lowercase project slug for routing. REQUIRED if outcome=CAPTURE_CREATED. Pass '_unrouted' if you cannot determine the project from the transcript.

capture_kind.description: Optional. The dominant kind of content in the body.
